_comment: Tier-2 Layer-C: fenics Stokes MMS — third physics anchor. Tests Taylor-Hood mixed-element catalog API (basix.ufl.mixed_element with P2-vector + P1-scalar), saddle-point system + MUMPS direct solve, pressure-pinning at a single DOF (Stokes with Dirichlet u has p only determined up to constant). MMS: stream function ψ = sin(πx)²·sin(πy)² → u = curl(ψ) = (π·sin(πx)²·sin(2πy), -π·sin(2πx)·sin(πy)²) which is divergence-free by construction; p = sin(πx)·cos(πy) (zero mean on [0,1]² since ∫cos(πy)dy=0). f computed UFL-symbolically as -ν·Δu + grad(p). Asserts P2 u L2 error <= 5e-4, P1 p L2 error <= 5e-3, P2 u EOC in [2.5, 3.5] (theoretical 3.0 for L2), P1 p EOC in [1.7, 3.0] (theoretical 2.0 but Taylor-Hood SUPER-CONVERGES on Cartesian-symmetric meshes to ~2.6+). Verified on 2026-06-01: u L2 = 1.40e-4, p L2 = 4.43e-4, u EOC=2.996, p EOC=2.634. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): dropping grad(p_ex) from f leaves (u_ex, 0) as the exact solution, so the run still completes and prints P2_u=1.399776e-04 with u EOC 2.996 — velocity untouched — while p_h goes to zero: P1_p=5.000000e-01 (= ||p_ex||_L2) with p EOC 0.000. Two 'FAIL:' lines then trip the forbid list. The one-leg design is deliberate: it shows the pressure assertion is live and not carried by the velocity one. Note the expect list is prefixes only, which any value satisfies; the discrimination is carried entirely by the forbid on 'FAIL:'. Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.

_mutation.note: Antidote: omit grad(p_ex) from the manufactured load. (u_ex, 0) is then the exact solution of the mutated system, so the VELOCITY leg is untouched and still converges at ~3 while the pressure collapses — which isolates the pressure assertion instead of breaking everything.
